content_sections.heading: About HBCH&RC and SBC Exports Ltd.
content_sections.text: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre is a cancer hospital on the Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur, Bihar. M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. describes itself as an outsourcing agency that supplies manpower services to HBCH&RC, Muzaffarpur on a contract basis. Nurses selected through this walk-in will be deployed at the hospital by the agency.

rows.monthly_remuneration: Rs. 33,000/- (GNM with Diploma in Oncology / Post Basic / B.Sc. Nursing); Rs. 31,000/- (GNM freshers)

content_sections.heading: HBCH&RC Nurse Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 30 years as on the date of the walk-in interview. The notice adds that deserving and bright candidates may be given age relaxation. General Nursing & Midwifery plus Diploma in Oncology Nursing (OR) Basic or Post Basic B.Sc. (Nursing) or GNM. Candidates should be eligible to register with the Indian Nursing Council / State Nursing Council. General Nursing & Midwifery and Basic or Post Basic B.Sc. (Nursing) should be recognised by the Indian Nursing Council / State Nursing Council. Hepatitis vaccination must be completed. GNM freshers can apply too. Their pay is lower than that of candidates who also hold the oncology diploma or a nursing degree. For the full eligibility details of the post, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through the walk-in interview. If a large number of candidates turn up, an MCQ test will be held first. The eligible candidates from that test will then be shortlisted for a skill test or interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on a contract basis through M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. It is first given for six months and can be extended if required. The place of deployment is Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Muzaffarpur. Accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HBCH&RC Nurse Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check that you meet the education, registration and age conditions on the walk-in date. Get the documents listed below ready, both in original and as one set of self-attested copies. Report on 30 October 2026, between 08.30 am and 9.30 am, at: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) – 842004. Take the MCQ test if one is held, and then the skill test or interview. Bio-data Recent passport size photograph PAN card Aadhar card Educational certificates Experience certificates

faq.question: Q1. Who is hiring for these Nurse posts?
faq.answer: M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. is hiring under advertisement no. OS/MUZ/2026/94. It is an outsourcing agency that supplies manpower to HBCH&RC, Muzaffarpur on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. Can GNM freshers attend the walk-in?
faq.answer: Yes. GNM is one of the accepted qualifications, and the notice sets a monthly remuneration of Rs. 31,000/- for GNM freshers.

faq.question: Q3. Who gets Rs. 33,000 per month?
faq.answer: Rs. 33,000/- is paid to GNM holders with a Diploma in Oncology, and to Post Basic or B.Sc. (Nursing) holders.

faq.question: Q4. Is nursing council registration required?
faq.answer: Candidates should be eligible to register with the Indian Nursing Council / State Nursing Council. Their GNM or B.Sc. (Nursing) qualification must also be recognised by that council.

faq.question: Q5. Is any vaccination required?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must have completed their Hepatitis vaccination.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any relaxation in the 30-year age limit?
faq.answer: The notice says deserving and bright candidates may be given age relaxation. The age is counted as on the walk-in date, 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Will there be a written test?
faq.answer: Only if many candidates turn up. In that case an MCQ test will be held, followed by a skill test or interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is first for six months and can be extended if required.

faq.question: Q9. Will accommodation be provided to candidates from outside Muzaffarpur?
faq.answer: No. The notice says accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates.
